مُجْمَلٌ [pass. part. n. of 4, q. v. ―
-b2- Also, applied to a phrase or the like,] properly, Including, or implying, a number of things, many and unexplained: (Er-Rághib, TA:) as used by the lawyers, [confused, or] requiring explanation. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
